response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across web, embedded, and distributed systems, including direct current experience building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling in an agentic-workflow context, which aligns closely with the role's AI-native mindset. His background includes genuine high-throughput distributed systems work (Sociomantic, millions of requests/sec) and strong TypeScript skills. The major gap is the complete absence of Python in his skills or work history despite it being an explicit must-have, and the resume lacks clear evidence of stakeholder management, on-call/incident response, or agile ceremony participation at the level described.
strengths: Current hands-on experience building AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflow tooling — directly matches the role's AI-native baseline expectation
Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems experience (e.g., micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests/sec at Sociomantic)
Broad, deep systems thinking demonstrated across 15+ years spanning web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure domains, plus software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based dev)
concerns: No mention of Python anywhere in skills or experience, despite it being an explicit must-have technical skill
No clear evidence of cross-functional stakeholder management or bridging engineering/product perspectives
No explicit mention of on-call/incident response ownership or agile sprint ceremonies (scrum, sprint planning)

key_factors.factor: Current AI-agent infrastructure / agentic tooling experience
